## Purpose and scope

The saRNA Database is being developed as a structured literature resource for small activating RNA research. The associated draft review frames the resource around reported saRNA sequences and their experimental context, with annotations that may support future analysis of sequence, genomic, cellular, and activity-related features.

The initial public site is a placeholder. It does not publish the working workbook, manuscript data, database records, or unpublished metadata.

## Attribution

Department or institutional attribution will be added after the responsible organization confirms the wording.

## Governance and stewardship

The database will be maintained through documented release procedures. The draft project scope includes manual curation from publications and patents, sequence-level annotations, experimental conditions, reported activity, and genomic context. The finalized Excel workbook will be the authoritative source for each release; validation, CSV export, versioning, correction handling, and manual Zenodo upload are described in the [future data-pipeline documentation](https://github.com/{{< var github-organization >}}/{{< var repository-name >}}/blob/main/docs/future-data-pipeline.md).

See [the data license](https://github.com/{{< var github-organization >}}/{{< var repository-name >}}/blob/main/LICENSE-DATA.md) and [the code license](https://github.com/{{< var github-organization >}}/{{< var repository-name >}}/blob/main/LICENSE) in the repository once its organization is confirmed.
